minutes.headline: TCP committee finalized its Town Meeting update presentation, handouts and presenter, and elected a new clerk.
minutes.summary: The committee welcomed a new member from the planning board and elected a clerk. It spent most of the meeting editing the architect's slide deck and the chair's outline for the upcoming special town meeting update. It agreed the chair will present, with five map pages as handouts, and no cost figures will be given yet.

votes.motion: Nominate Brian as clerk of the committee (nominated and seconded)

budget_items.what_was_said: Residents are eager for numbers, but a member said none would be ready by the special town meeting. The architects and engineers are only now starting to work on numbers.
The chair said the presentation will state that a detailed cost estimate will come from the design development stage and will be presented at a future town meeting.

decisions.decision: The chair will give the town meeting presentation, then hand over to the architect.
Handouts will be five map pages: overall plan, office wing, community space, meeting room area, school area, plus the site plan with parking. Presentations will be posted online.
Next meeting planned for the 30th at 5:30.
No Q&A invited during the presentation; the committee will encourage participation at later meetings.
